gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the precise quantifier error in the negation: the violating component may depend on y, whereas the proof assumes one common component j for all y and k. It also identifies that the subsequent contradiction therefore fails to establish the uniform Slater constant and supplies a repair using MFCQ, continuity, and compactness.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries concern the failed proof of the uniform Slater condition: the negation only permits a component varying with y, but bc-ineq1 selects a single component uniformly over y. Consequently, the one-component MFCQ contradiction does not establish the uniform margin needed for multiplier bounds and downstream results.

component_coverage.gold_component: The proof incorrectly moves the component existential quantifier outside the quantifiers over y and k, assuming one fixed violating component and thereby failing to prove the uniform Slater constant and its dependent bounds.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly states the varying-j versus common-j distinction, identifies reliance of the contradiction on the common j, notes the unsupported uniform Slater and downstream multiplier claims, and proposes a specific compactness/MFCQ repair. This independently diagnoses the complete substantive gold concern.
